summary: Eight snowmobilers in two separate groups stuck and lost in Fish Creek Drainage west of Long Lake during heavy snowfall; one group made fire, the other (sleds abandoned) could not. RCSAR deployed a team over concern the subjects might not survive the night; Steamboat Powdercats groomed the route and guided riders to the top of Buffalo Pass, then ski-mounted members led the team to the subjects. Mission ran overnight and finished at 1:00 p.m. the following afternoon; all subjects and volunteers extracted safely.
location: Fish Creek Drainage west of Long Lake, Buffalo Pass area
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; Steamboat Powdercats
